assessment.note: Findings describe the misconfigurations intentionally declared in terraform/insecure-lab. They are the expected scanner output for that lab, not results captured from a real AWS account.

findings.title: Bucket with public-read ACL
findings.remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access and remove the public ACL

findings.title: Access key older than 90 days
findings.remediation: Rotate the key; prefer IAM roles and short-lived credentials

findings.title: Inline policy allows Action * on Resource *
findings.remediation: Replace with a least-privilege, resource-scoped policy

findings.title: Security group allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0
findings.remediation: Remove port 22 or restrict it to a bastion CIDR; prefer SSM Session Manager

findings.title: No multi-region trail configured
findings.remediation: Create a multi-region trail with log file validation

findings.title: Root account MFA not enabled
findings.remediation: Enable hardware MFA on root; avoid root for daily operations

findings.title: VPC Flow Logs disabled
findings.remediation: Enable flow logs to CloudWatch Logs or S3

findings.title: Bucket versioning disabled
findings.remediation: Enable versioning for recovery from deletion and ransomware

findings.title: GuardDuty detector disabled
findings.remediation: Enable GuardDuty in every active region

findings.title: EBS encryption by default is off
findings.remediation: Turn on account-level EBS encryption by default

findings.title: Password policy does not require symbols
findings.remediation: Require symbols, 14+ characters and reuse prevention

findings.title: Server access logging not enabled
findings.remediation: Enable S3 server access logging to a dedicated log bucket
